title: 2024 Form 10-K

evidence.locator: p. 29, Consolidated Statements of Operations, FY2024 Products and Services net sales and cost of sales
p. 47, Note 13, net sales by country, FY2024
evidence.facts: China includes Hong Kong and Taiwan. U.S. is a country disclosure, not the Americas operating segment. The supplied country totals and Products/Services totals do not disclose their joint allocation.
FY2024 spans 52 weeks and ends September 28, 2024. These are annual net sales, not balances, customer counts or cash receipts.

precision: Whole USD million. Bounds concern all nonnegative joint allocations consistent with these displayed annual marginals. No estimate of the actual undisclosed mix is substituted.
rights: Attributed factual observations and concise definitions only. Issuer material is excluded from the project MIT license. Full source documents are not redistributed.
extract_origin: Manually normalized financial facts checked against the cited primary disclosure. Not an original-document capture.
